name: Airburst
targets: all creatures and unattended objects in the area

outcomes.success: The creature takes a –2 status penalty to checks made during its reactions until the end of your turn.
outcomes.failure: As success, and the creature is pushed 5 feet away from you.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The creature is pushed 5 feet away from you and can't use reactions until the end of your turn.

heightening.text: Increase the area to a 10-foot emanation and increase the distance objects and creatures are pushed to 10 feet.

entries: A blast of wind wildly pushes everything nearby.
Unattended objects of 1 Bulk or less are pushed 5 feet away from you. Large or smaller creatures must attempt a Fortitude save.
